metadata.question: Through the months of December 2018 and January 2019, did sourthern African countries (Namibia, Botswana, Lesotho) recieve less rain than the long-term average for the same two-month period from 2000 to 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: CHIRPS (daily rainfall) or GPM (global precipitation) - Use CHIRPS for better long-term coverage (2000-2019) - Date: December 2018 - January 2019 vs. all Dec-Jan periods from 2000-2019 - Location: Namibia, Botswana, Lesotho (southern Africa) 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for CHIRPS (it's a precipitation product) - Just sum rainfall over the period 3. Logic: - Calculate total rainfall for Dec 2018 - Jan 2019 - Calculate average total rainfall for all Dec-Jan periods (2000-2019) - Compare: if 2018-2019 < long-term average → A (Yes), else → B (No) - Handle C1 (no data), C2 (no valid pixels), C3 (calculation failure) ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Define geometries for southern African countries namibia = ee.Geometry.Polygon([[[11.7, -17.9], [25.3, -17.9], [25.3, -28.9], [11.7, -28.9], [11.7, -17.9]]]) botswana = ee.Geometry.Polygon([[[19.9, -17.8], [29.4, -17.8], [29.4, -26.9], [19.9, -26.9], [19.9, -17.8]]]) lesotho = ee.Geometry.Polygon([[[27.0, -28.6], [29.5, -28.6], [29.5, -30.7], [27.0, -30.7], [27.0, -28.6]]]) region = ee.Geometry.MultiPolygon([namibia, botswana, lesotho]) # 2. import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Define geometries for southern African countries
namibia = ee.Geometry.Polygon([[[11.7, -17.9], [25.3, -17.9], [25.3, -28.9], [11.7, -28.9], [11.7, -17.9]]])
botswana = ee.Geometry.Polygon([[[19.9, -17.8], [29.4, -17.8], [29.4, -26.9], [19.9, -26.9], [19.9, -17.8]]])
lesotho = ee.Geometry.Polygon([[[27.0, -28.6], [29.5, -28.6], [29.5, -30.7], [27.0, -30.7], [27.0, -28.6]]])

region = ee.Geometry.MultiPolygon([namibia, botswana, lesotho])

# 2. Load CHIRPS precipitation data
chirps = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY')

# 3. Calculate rainfall for Dec 2018 - Jan 2019
target_period = chirps.filter(ee.Filter.date('2018-12-01', '2019-02-01'))
print(f"Target period images: {target_period.size().getInfo()}")

if target_period.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("No data for Dec 2018 - Jan 2019")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    target_rainfall = target_period.select('precipitation').sum()
    
    # Check valid pixels
    target_count = target_rainfall.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=region,
        scale=5000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('precipitation').getInfo()
    
    if target_count == 0:
        print("No valid pixels in target period")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    else:
        target_total = target_rainfall.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
            geometry=region,
            scale=5000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('precipitation').getInfo()
        
        # 4. Calculate long-term average for Dec-Jan (2000-2019)
        dec_jan_totals = []
        for year in range(2000, 2020):
            start_date = f"{year}-12-01"
            end_date = f"{year+1}-02-01"
            
            period_col = chirps.filter(ee.Filter.date(start_date, end_date))
            if period_col.size().getInfo() > 0:
                period_sum = period_col.select('precipitation').sum()
                period_mean = period_sum.reduceRegion(
                    reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
                    geometry=region,
                    scale=5000,
                    maxPixels=1e9
                ).get('precipitation').getInfo()
                
                if period_mean is not None:
                    dec_jan_totals.append(period_mean)
                    print(f"{year}-{year+1}: {period_mean:.2f} mm")
        
        if len(dec_jan_totals) == 0:
            print("No valid long-term data")
            print("<answer>C3</answer>")
        else:
            long_term_avg = sum(dec_jan_totals) / len(dec_jan_totals)
            
            print(f"\nDec 2018 - Jan 2019: {target_total:.2f} mm")
            print(f"Long-term average (2000-2019): {long_term_avg:.2f} mm")
            print(f"Valid pixels: {int(target_count)}")
            
            if target_total is None or long_term_avg is None:
                print("<answer>C3</answer>")
            elif target_total < long_term_avg:
                print("<answer>A</answer>")
            else:
                print("<answer>B</answer>")
